data:
@FSC.Peano2.exists_remainder_bound : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ V]
  {f : V → ℝ} {x : V} {l : V →L[ℝ] ℝ} {B : V →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] ℝ},
  FSC.Peano2 f x l B →
    (∃ M, ∀ (z : V), ‖f z‖ ≤ M) → ∃ C, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (h : V), ‖FSC.peanoRemainder f x l B h‖ ≤ C * ‖h‖ ^ 2

@FSC.Peano2.tendsto_secondOrder_quotient : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ V]
  {f : V → ℝ} {x : V} {l : V →L[ℝ] ℝ} {B : V →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] ℝ},
  FSC.Peano2 f x l B →
    ∀ {u : ℝ → V},
      Filter.Tendsto u (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) →
        ∀ (y : V),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun s => (f (x + √s • (u s + y)) - f x - l (√s • (u s + y))) / s) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
            (nhds (1 / 2 * (B y) y))

@FSC.Peano2.tendsto_integral_secondOrder : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ V]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V] {f : V → ℝ} {x : V} {l : V →L[ℝ] ℝ} {B : V →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] ℝ},
  FSC.Peano2 f x l B →
    Measurable f →
      (∃ M, ∀ (z : V), ‖f z‖ ≤ M) →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure V) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => ‖y‖ ^ 2) μ →
            ∀ {u : ℝ → V},
              Filter.Tendsto u (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) →
                Filter.Tendsto (fun s => ∫ (y : V), (f (x + √s • (u s + y)) - f x - l (√s • (u s + y))) / s ∂μ)
                  (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (∫ (y : V), 1 / 2 * (B y) y ∂μ))

@FSC.Peano2.hasDerivWithinAt_noiseAverage : ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ V]
  [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace V] [BorelSpace V] [CompleteSpace V] [SecondCountableTopology V] {f : V → ℝ} {x : V}
  {l : V →L[ℝ] ℝ} {B : V →L[ℝ] V →L[ℝ] ℝ},
  FSC.Peano2 f x l B →
    Measurable f →
      (∃ M, ∀ (z : V), ‖f z‖ ≤ M) →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure V) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ],
          ∫ (y : V), y ∂μ = 0 →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => ‖y‖ ^ 2) μ →
              ∀ {v : ℝ → V} {v₀ : V},
                v 0 = 0 →
                  Filter.Tendsto (fun s => s⁻¹ • v s) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds v₀) →
                    HasDerivWithinAt (fun s => ∫ (y : V), f (x + v s + √s • y) ∂μ)
                      (l v₀ + 1 / 2 * ∫ (y : V), (B y) y ∂μ) (Set.Ici 0) 0
